user.title: IMILAB / Mijia EC2
user.description: Sign in to the Xiaomi account that owns the cameras. Your gateways are then found automatically.

menu_options.qr: Scan a QR code in the Mi Home app (recommended)
menu_options.credentials: Sign in with username and password
menu_options.token: Use a user ID and passToken (advanced)

qr.title: Sign in with a QR code
qr.description:
Pick the region the account belongs to - the same one the Mi Home app is set to. Asking the wrong region simply finds no devices.

The next screen shows a QR code. No password, captcha or verification code is needed.

credentials.title: Xiaomi account
credentials.description:
Use the account that OWNS the cameras. An account they are only shared with is never issued the P2P keys needed to stream, so it cannot work.

Pick the region the account belongs to - the same one the Mi Home app is set to. Asking the wrong region simply finds no devices.

data.username: Xiaomi ID, email or phone number

token.title: User ID and passToken
token.description: For accounts where a password sign-in will not complete. The passToken looks like V1:… and is what an existing working setup already stores.

select.title: Choose a gateway
select.description: More than one EC2 gateway is on this account. Add one now; run this again to add the next.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Xiaomi no longer accepts the stored token, so the cameras have stopped streaming. Sign in again with the account that owns them.

menu_options.qr: Scan a QR code in the Mi Home app (recommended)
menu_options.credentials: Sign in with username and password
menu_options.token: Use a user ID and passToken (advanced)

captcha.title: Enter the code from the image
captcha.description:
Xiaomi is asking for a captcha before it will accept the password. This usually appears after a few failed sign-in attempts.

![captcha]({image})

Type the characters shown above.

code.title: Enter the verification code
code.description:
Xiaomi has sent a code to **{destination}**.

Type it in below. There is no web page to visit - the verification is handled here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Xiaomi cloud.
error.captcha_wrong: That code was not accepted. A new image has been issued - try again.
error.captcha_required: Xiaomi is asking for a captcha.
error.code_quota: Xiaomi will not send another verification code right now - too many have been requested. Retrying keeps the limit alive. Go back and sign in with a QR code instead: it needs no code and is not affected.
error.qr_expired: The QR code expired before it was scanned. Submit again for a new one.
error.qr_failed: Xiaomi did not complete the QR sign-in. Submit again for a new code.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Xiaomi cloud to list your devices.
abort.already_configured: Every gateway on this account is already set up.
abort.no_gateways: No EC2 gateways were found on this account in the selected region. Check that you picked the right region, and that you signed in with the account that OWNS the cameras rather than one they are shared with.
abort.no_address: The gateway has no reachable address. It must be on the same network as Home Assistant.
abort.gateway_gone: That gateway is no longer available.
abort.wrong_account: That is a different Xiaomi account from the one these cameras were set up with. Sign in with the account that owns them.

progress.qr_scan:
Open the **Mi Home** app signed in to the account that **owns** the cameras, tap **+** then **Scan**, and scan this code:

![QR code]({qr_image})

Or open [this link]({login_url}) and sign in on Xiaomi's own page.

The code is valid for about 5 minutes. This step continues on its own once you confirm.

init.title: Streaming ports
init.description: RTSP must stay reachable from your network if external players (for example Kodi via IPTV Simple) pull these streams. Binding it to 127.0.0.1 will silently break them.
